comments.story: The Moorish invention that tamed Spain's mountains
comments.why: Covers Petra's water-engineering civilization and its collapse.
comments.text: It wasn't in the Sahara, but the civilization at Petra (in what is now SW Jordan) was built around sophisticated hydraulic engineering. It eventually collapsed when earthquakes damaged the system beyond their capacity to repair. Being subjugated by Rome didn't help. [VIDEO]
